title: Oathmaker
summary: Oathmaker is a psychic spell used by Teien Casterwill that forces the target to tell the truth to the caster. The spell forces the target say what he or she considers the truth, not necessarily the actual truth. In this regard, it is much like the spell version of a truth serum. This spell can even be used long distances with a Tome.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Oathmaker was used by [[Teien Casterwill]], projected via [[Cypherdex]], to interrogate a captured [[Silent Soldier]]. {{source|The Casterwill Connection}}
